Name: Kenneth's Starter Gift
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Starter Gift[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]A simple starter pack to make your first days easier. Comes in 4 versions, you can install one or install all if you want to be OP.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Choose your style:[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Starter Gift - Balanced - for a chill early boost[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2 Chest, 60 Parsnip Seeds, 30 Potato Seeds, 20 Kale Seeds, 10 Bean Starter, 150 Wood, 100 Stone, 50 Fiber, 5 Sprinkler, 20 Field Snack, 2500 gold[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Starter Gift - Fast Farmer - for faster progress[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3 Chest, 50 Strawberry Seeds, 40 Potato Seeds, 30 Kale Seeds, 10 Coffee Bean, 10 Quality Sprinkler, 2 Keg, 300 Wood, 200 Stone, 5000 gold[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Starter Gift - OP God - for OP start[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2 Big Chest, 5 Ancient Seeds, 100 Strawberry Seeds, 20 Starfruit Seeds, 12 Iridium Sprinkler, 12 Keg, 12 Preserves Jar, 20 Iridium Bar, 10 Diamond, 50000 gold[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Kenneth's Starter Gift - Ultimate God - for when you just want to have fun[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]5 Big Stone Chest, 20 Prismatic Shard, 20 Ancient Seeds, 100 Starfruit Seeds, 20 Rare Seeds, 50 Iridium Sprinkler, 2 Junimo Chest, 20 Hopper, 100 Iridium Bar, 20 Battery Pack, 1 Galaxy Sword, 1 Stardrop, 1000000 gold[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to use:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Just install one folder you like. If you want to be super OP, you can install all 4, the items will stack.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Note: Inventory full at start? Place the Chest first, then store extra items inside. [/b][/size][b][size=4]The Chest is there to help you.[/size][/b]

[b][size=4]Safe to uninstall:[/size][/b]
[size=4][b]Once you got the items, just save your game or sleep for a day to save. After that you can safely uninstall the mod and keep all the items.[/b][/size]

[b][size=4]Requirements: SMAPI, Content Patcher[/size][/b]
[size=4][b]Compatible with any farm map.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Made for fun, play how you want.[/b][/size]
